source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules revision 1.5 (Soul magic: Outburst 2.0, accepted 8 Nov 2026; docs/design/outburst-2.0-proposal.md). Module names from the 2020 Recovered Design Notes.

cycle.text: Begin (2 AP, Swift 1) opens a ready design at stage 0 (+1 Strain). Pump (1 AP) +1 stage, to 4. Release (1 AP) fires it. Held past your turn: +1 stage free at your next turn start (the swell), +1 Strain (+2 Flooded). Empathy 3: 1 free Pump a round; Empathy 7: 2.

calming.text: Every turn start: −1 Strain, always (before the swell).
A turn of stillness: end a turn in which you didn't Begin, Pump or Feed: −1 more.
Fighting it out: your first weapon attack each turn (melee or shot): −1.
Tending others: your first heal, stim, shield or cleanse given to an ally each turn: −1.
Let it go (free, on your turn): drop the held Outburst; Strain falls by its stage; the meter +1.
Steady the heart (1 AP, only while holding): −1 Strain, and the held Outburst doesn't swell at your next turn start.

aura.text: Holding an elemental Outburst: enemies adjacent to you at the start of your turn take 5 Elemental and the tone's stage-1 rider.

resonance.text: A release by an ally after another ally's release in the same round: +0.2 on the stage multiplier for each earlier ally releaser this round.

heart_overwatch.text: While holding (and watching), release as your reaction when an enemy enters your design's reach.

feed.text: Absorb a glyph on your own tile into your held Outburst: +1 stage; the glyph is gone.

second_school.text: A second school with its own option, at half strength, after the first.

default_form.name: Bolt
default_form.text: One target at the aim, within reach (4 tiles + the Soul range bonus); rolls Will Power against Defense.

stage_shift.text: Element riders count one stage higher in Flooded air, one lower in Thin air (0 to 4).

cost_rules: (school base + modules + 10 for a second school + the tone's cost) × the band's Soul cost × (1 − 5% × (Insight − 1)), minimum 5; +20% under a Right Brain Debuff. Paid at Begin.

limits.tones: one at Visualization 1; more from tutors or plates

notes: Every number from rules 1.5 is provisional until the damage balance pass. Forms are modules (family 'form', one per design, they take a slot); tones take no slot. Retired modules are listed in 'retired' with what an old design gets instead.

schools.name: Damage
schools.text: 20 damage × the Soul multiplier × the stage multiplier (Raw: Soul damage, armour ignored; an element: Elemental, armour half). Bolt and Lance roll Will Power against Defense; the areas don't roll.

schools.name: Buff
schools.text: Allies: heal 30 × Healing multiplier × the stage multiplier, or Inspired (+2 to hit) or Guarded (+2 Defense) for 2 rounds.

schools.name: Control
schools.text: Push or pull 3 tiles, or Pinned, or Slowed, 2 rounds (Body save).

schools.name: Status
schools.text: Fear, Shaken, Confused, or a Left or Right Brain Debuff, 2 rounds (Heart or Brain save).

tones.name: Raw
tones.text: Soul damage: ignores armour. No rider.

4.text: Burning 2 rounds; it spreads to foes next to each target; the ground under the target burns.

2.text: Ignores half cover; chains to 1 more enemy within 2 tiles at half.

3.text: Ignores half cover; chains to 1 more enemy within 2 tiles at half.

4.text: Ignores half cover; chains to 2 more within 2 tiles at half; Shaken (Heart save).
Slowed and Pinned 1 round, no save.

tones.name: Stone
tones.text: Elemental (stone): armour counts half at stage 0; from stage 1 it counts in full and the hit deals +10.

4.text: Armour in full, +10; Prone (Body save); rubble rises on the empty tiles around the target.
Pushes the target 3 tiles and everyone else within 1 of it 2 tiles.
Corroded, no save, and Defense −2 more while it lasts.

retired.why: Replaced by the Burst shape (radius 1; Rain + Size becomes Burst + Size).
Its sight-free half became Ether; moving an ally is the Narrator's (no engine effect).
Retired: the shapes (Burst, Wave, Lance) and Storm's chains cover more than one target.
Retired: Fire's Burning, Acid's Corroded and the held aura carry damage over time.
Retired: Heart Overwatch does it (release as a reaction when an enemy enters reach).
Retired: holding is the delayed blast now.
Retired: the engine never counted casts; stages do the growing.

items.name: Move
items.text: Far: reach 8 tiles instead of 4 (+ the Soul range bonus). Bolt and Burst only matter; a Wave, Lance or Aura keeps its own length.

items.name: Homing
items.text: +2 to the release roll and ignores half cover (Bolt and Lance roll; the areas don't).

items.text: Flips the effect: damage becomes a shield of the same size on an ally (enemies in the area are skipped); the Narrator rules a flipped debuff.

items.name: Size
items.text: A shape grows by one: Wave cone 4, Burst radius 2, Aura radius 2, Lance 6 tiles. Needs a shape (a Bolt can't take it).
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Random
items.text: Cost −10, but the engine picks the aim among every creature within reach (a Bolt or Burst lands on one of them; a Wave or Lance faces one).
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Impact
items.text: Default: the effect happens when the Outburst lands. No change (kept so old designs stay readable).
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: At Once
items.text: A Bolt or Lance lands with no roll, at half damage (area shapes never roll).
items.source_note: module name from the 2020 spell-crafting notes; cost and effect are new

items.name: Wave
items.text: Shape: a 3-tile cone from you toward the aim (Size: 4). Everyone in it, no roll; damage ×0.7.
items.look: a violet crescent rolling off your chest

items.name: Burst
items.text: Shape: radius 1 around the aimed tile (Size: radius 2). Everyone in it, no roll; damage ×0.7. Old Rain designs become Burst.
items.look: a heart-shaped bloom opening at the aim

items.name: Aura
items.text: Shape: radius 1 around you, all at once (Size: radius 2); no aim. You are spared unless it's a Buff. Damage ×0.6.
items.look: a ring of violet heat breaking off you

items.name: Lance
items.text: Shape: a straight 4-tile line from you toward the aim (8 directions), piercing everyone on it (Size: 6); walls stop it. Each target rolls; damage ×0.8.
items.look: a narrow violet spear of light
